title: Citation audit: verify the key papers and numbers we plan to quote
outcome: Every paper/number likely to reach the abstract is verified against the paper itself (via Lacuna get_paper fulltext or arXiv)
acceptance: checks Who&When 53.5%/14.2% and CHIEF/FAMAS figures in the paper text
confirms existence, authors, venue/year of Retro, Warp, Aire, Taser, GoEx, Atomix, Cordon, State Footprints, DeltaBox, MAST
table: claim, source, verified yes/no/partial, exact location, safe wording
summary: Audited 27 claims; table + DROP list in research/RES-10.md. Who&When 53.5/14.2 is in the abstract and reproducible from Table 1 as a 4-cell mean, but from two different methods (all-at-once agent, step-by-step step), GPT-4o; never say one method gets both. FAMAS (57.61/29.35) and CHIEF tables match; CHIEF does not win every cell (FAMAS 41.38 step hand-crafted). Cordon 45/45 vs 14/45 verified but is the authors' own 45-case suite with self-derived baseline adapters; EuroSys'27 is only a header, drop. MAST 94% is few-shot o1 accuracy (kappa 0.77): quote kappa; NeurIPS unconfirmed. Venues confirmed: Retro OSDI'10, Warp SOSP'11, Aire SOSP'13, Taser SOSP'05, Sagas SIGMOD'87, Crosby-Wallach USENIX Sec'09, Who&When ICML'25. State Footprints is a vision paper (rollback unimplemented) and close prior art; DeltaBox is whole-sandbox, v2/title conflict with RES-06. Cordon/CHIEF/State Footprints/DeltaBox read via WebFetch (second-hand): Aarav should eyeball those numbers.
